# sendgrid_template (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid transactional template by ID, including a summary of its versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_template" "welcome_email" {
  id = "d-abcd1234"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The template's UUID.

### Read-Only

- `generation` (String) Whether this template supports dynamic replacements: `legacy` or `dynamic`.
- `name` (String) The name of this transactional template.
- `updated_at` (String) The time this template was last updated.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Summary of each version of this template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this is the active version.
- `id` (String) The version's UUID.
- `name` (String) The name of this version.
- `subject` (String) The subject of this version.
- `updated_at` (String) The time this version was last updated.
